devon: short broadcast rolled a small perf patch to reduce unnecessary kernel pathway switches during short-token completions.

ravi: TL;DR numbers?

devon: p95 down ~12% for short-completion routes (seq <= 64), median unaffected. avg token-GPU cycles down ~10% on sampled traffic. CPU overhead for scheduler +1.5% (expected).

hema: which kernel decisions changed?

devon: we now canonicalize attention layout earlier in the execution pipeline and avoid the expensive short-to-long kernel handoff when the next-token budget is small. Practically this removes one memcpy + one kernel launch on the fast-path.

devon: safe config flip we used:
```
exec.path_canonicalize = true
exec.handoff_threshold_tokens = 12
```

sam: deployment scope? any exclusions?

devon: rolled to low-latency clusters in us-west and eu-west for rwd-small-chat & rwd-medium-chat. Excluded streaming-heavy routes and any customer routes opted into "latency-first".

ravi: incidents?

devon: none. We saw a small uptick in scheduler CPU for 30m while the rollout autoscales additional daemon pods, but autoscaler handled it. No customer impact.

ops-bot: deploy: kernel-canonicalize-v1 promoted to default in region-us-west at 2026-07-21T11:03:10Z :white_check_mark:

hema: alerting and dashboards?

devon: dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/kernels/short-path-win
runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/kernel-canonicalize-v1
new alerts: exec.kernel.handoff.count and exec.shortpath.misses.p95. Also added a 1h post-rollout check that posts to #eng-runtime if p95 regresses >5%.

sam: any customer-facing policy changes?

devon: yes small policy change: default execution policy for seq<=64 is "short-path-prefer". Customers needing absolute determinism across kernel boundaries can opt out with `route.exec_policy = "handoff-consistent"`.

ravi: please prepare a 1-paragraph item for #announcements. keep it simple: perf win + opt-out note + links.

devon: will drop it tomorrow morning. thanks team.

hema: filing follow-ups: ticket #5332 (telemetry for handoff misses), #5333 (autoscaler tuning for scheduler CPU), #5334 (announce blurb).

devon: closing thread. ping me for any post-rollout oddities.
